questions.stem: A 78-year-old man was admitted to the hospital 3 days earlier with a suspected pathologic fracture of the right femur. Today he became acutely short of breath. Current vital signs include a heart rate of 115 beats/min, blood pressure of 92/70 mm Hg, and respiratory rate of 32/min. Oxygen saturation is 94% on 4 L of oxygen via nasal cannula. He is anxious and tachypneic, but lung sounds are clear and symmetric. The heart rhythm is regular and no murmurs are appreciated. What is the likely cause of dyspnea
